title: Pansori and the Song of Chunhyang
summary: Pansori, a musical storytelling form for a singer and a drummer, originated in south-west Korea in the seventeenth century, probably from the narrative songs of shamans. A repertoire of twelve works grew up, including the Song of Chunhyang, and gained the interest of Joseon's elite literati in the eighteenth century. UNESCO inscribed pansori on its intangible heritage list in 2008.

uncertainty.note: UNESCO and NVCC place the origin in the seventeenth century (1601–1700); the 1700 in the target id is only a lookup key.
